title: Surreal Oracle Landscape
description: A surreal desert scene features a winding black road leading to a large cracked crystal ball on a golden stand. Inside the orb is a three-eyed figure with purple curly hair, a mustache, and white bunny ears, surrounded by floating eyeballs and geometric shapes. In the foreground, a blue-robed figure with a large single eye for a head holds a small orb while standing on the road. The orange terrain includes purple flowers, cracked red mountains, and a distant camel-like creature.
